about_the_game:
Trade cargo for passengers in a whole new ETS2 journey! Take a seat behind the wheel – not of a truck, but of a coach. The Coaches DLC brings a new dimension to the ETS2 experience by introducing scheduled passenger transport across Europe.

Explore the continent from a fresh perspective. From narrow city streets to scenic highways, your driving skills will be put to the test as you manage multiple stops, stay on schedule, and ensure a smooth, comfortable ride.

In this new DLC, you’ll get behind the wheel of iconic, fully licensed coach models, such as the Scania Touring, Volvo 9700 DD, and MAN Lion’s Coach. Drive from large central bus stations in bustling cities to remote local stops off the beaten path.

Keep in mind that everything you see here is still a work in progress. Make sure to support us by adding this DLC to your Steam wishlist!

name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Coaches

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon RX 460 or Intel HD 630 (2GB VRAM)
  • Hard Drive: 25 GB available space (Euro Truck Simulator 2 base game)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or similar
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon RX 590 (2GB VRAM)
  • Hard Drive: 25 GB available space (Euro Truck Simulator 2 base game)
